metadata.title: Forget Nvidia, Marvell Earnings Are a Bigger Deal for the AI Trade<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Forget Nvidia, These Earnings Are a Bigger Deal for the AI Trade
Nvidia earnings have long been a key catalyst for the artificial-intelligence boom, but this time another chip company’s results may be more critical to revive the faltering trade.
